title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Explained: Spoiler-Free Guide to the Characters and Plot
summary: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 explained without spoilers: the Western Capital arc plot, where to watch, the schedule, new characters and the family tree.

**TL;DR**


- The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 premiered October 2, 2026 and streams every Friday at 8:00 a.m. PT on Crunchyroll. Part 1 runs 12 episodes through December 18, and Part 2 follows in April 2027.
- The new arc adapts light novel volume 5: a looming locust plague, famine rumors and a mysterious “immortal maiden” pull Maomao and Jinshi out of the capital and onto the road west.
- Among The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 characters, Bai Niangniang is the only brand-new one, while Basen, Lahan, Chou-u and Rikuson step into much bigger roles. The family tree and the ships fans follow most are covered below.

##


The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 plot: what the Western Capital arc is about


#


[The Apothecary Diaries Season 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Apothecary_Diaries_(TV_series)) trades rear-palace politics for a crisis in the fields. Back in the pleasure district with Chou-u, a young Shi clan survivor, Maomao reads a breakfast of fried locusts as a warning: the harvest is in trouble.


At court, Gyokuyou is now Empress, and Jinshi has dropped the eunuch act to serve as the Imperial Brother. Famine fears and rumors of an immortal maiden then draw Maomao, Jinshi and Basen toward the Western Capital, home of Gyokuyou’s family. True to form, Maomao’s cases start small (a sick patient here, a suspicious street show there) before snapping together into something much bigger.


###


The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 vs. the light novel


#


The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 begins at[light novel volume 5](https://comicbook.com/anime/news/the-apothecary-diaries-star-teases-the-biggest-change-in-season-3/) , which opens with the chapter “Locusts.” Seasons 1 and 2 ran 24 episodes each and covered volumes 1 to 4, so anime viewers can start reading at volume 5 without skipping anything.


The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 anime adapts the plot faithfully but at a brisker pace. The novel spends far more time inside Maomao’s head, so some of her dry inner commentary and medical tangents get trimmed for screen time. The anime also adds new scenes to connect episodes and provide visual gags, while cutting some conversations and background details from the books. Readers regularly unpack those cut thoughts in weekly episode threads, which is why book readers and anime-only fans can walk away from the same scene with different takeaways.


###


Where to watch The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 and release schedule


#


[Crunchyroll](https://www.crunchyroll.com/news/guides/2026/10/2/the-apothecary-diaries-season-3-where-to-watch-trailers-cast-more) holds the streaming rights to The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 in the US and most regions outside Asia. In the US, the new season is also available through the Crunchyroll channel on Prime Video, and single episodes can be bought on the Apple TV Store. Netflix carries the series only in some Asian regions.

##


Western Capital Arc Characters Explained


#


The Apothecary Diaries is built around Maomao and Jinshi, surrounded by a large court cast: the Emperor and his consorts, Jinshi’s household, the Verdigris House courtesans and the La clan. The Apothecary Diaries characters list for Season 3 is mostly returning faces (see[full character list](https://kusuriya.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Characters) ), led by the 11 characters:


Character Who they are in The Apothecary Diaries Role in Season 3


[Maomao](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/maomao-7pedn98z9wnz) Poison-curious apothecary raised in the Verdigris House and happiest testing a toxin on her own arm; former palace food taster Starts off the palace payroll, taking cases for ordinary people until the locust mystery pulls her back into imperial politics and onto the trip west


[Jinshi](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/jinshi-ep3w138n16ig) Impossibly handsome official who ran the rear palace while posing as a eunuch and kept recruiting Maomao to crack its mysteries Drops the eunuch act to serve in public as the Imperial Brother, and still finds every excuse to keep Maomao close, including the long trip west


[Gaoshun](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/gaoshun-tk8eu1afm6y7) Veteran officer who has watched over Jinshi since childhood, with the patience of a man used to cleaning up after his prince Back to serving the Emperor directly, now that the eunuch “Jinshi” no longer exists, while his son Basen takes the road west


Basen Gaoshun’s son, raised beside Jinshi; earnest, loyal and rarely subtle Travels west with Maomao and Jinshi and gets far more screen time; his straightforward style contrasts with Maomao’s suspicion


Lahan Lakan’s adopted heir, who sees the world as a set of numbers to balance Takes Maomao to a popular street show that turns out to be anything but harmless entertainment


[Lakan](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/lakan-qewk02o90tlw) Face-blind tactician who leads the La clan and is Maomao’s biological father Front and center in Season 3 promotional art, though the anime has not yet revealed his full part in the crisis


Chou-u Lively child who survived the Shi clan’s downfall Lives with Maomao in the pleasure district; an early episode ties him to the locust investigation


Rikuson Lakan’s former aide Featured on the Season 3 character posters


Pairin, Meimei, Joka The Three Princesses, top courtesans of the Verdigris House Maomao’s older-sister figures at home


Bai Niangniang New: a pale, mysterious “immortal maiden” The rumor at the center of the season (see below)


###


The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 new characters


#


Among The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 characters, only one is officially new: **Bai Niangniang** , voiced by Reina Ueda. Official materials describe her as a pale, mysterious immortal maiden, and fan coverage notes her white hair, white skin and red eyes. Her public performances look impossible to the crowds who watch them, which is exactly the kind of claim Maomao wants to test.


The rest of The Apothecary Diaries characters list for Season 3 is returning, but several side characters move up. The official poster set put Basen, Lahan, Chou-u and Rikuson next to Maomao, Jinshi, Gaoshun and the Three Princesses, so expect more of them as the arc continues.


##


The Apothecary Diaries family tree explained


#


**Spoiler warning:** this section reveals twists from Seasons 1 and 2. Skip to the next section if you have not finished Season 2.


The Apothecary Diaries family tree is built on[three bloodlines](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_The_Apothecary_Diaries_characters) : the imperial Ka clan, Maomao’s family across the La clan and the Verdigris House, and the Shi clan, which turns out to be tied to the imperial line.


###


The imperial family (Ka clan)


#


- The former Emperor and Empress Dowager Anshi are the current Emperor’s parents.
- The current Emperor is Jinshi’s biological father. His children with Empress Gyokuyou include Princess Lingli and the crown prince.
- Jinshi, whose real name is Ka Zuigetsu, was raised as the Emperor’s younger brother. As a newborn he was swapped with Anshi’s baby, so he grew up as her son.
- Ah-Duo, the Emperor’s former consort, is Jinshi’s birth mother. Her mother, Suiren, is now Jinshi’s lady-in-waiting, which makes her his grandmother.


###


Maomao’s family (La clan and the Verdigris House)


#


- Lakan, head of the La clan, is Maomao’s biological father.
- Fengxian, a former top courtesan of the Verdigris House, is her biological mother.
- Luomen, the former court doctor who raised her, is Lakan’s uncle, so he is also her great-uncle.
- Lahan is Lakan’s nephew and adopted heir, which makes him Maomao’s cousin by blood and her brother by adoption.
- The series hints that the Madam of the Verdigris House is Fengxian’s mother, which would make her Maomao’s grandmother.


###


The Shi clan


#


- Shishou, the Shi clan politician behind the rebellion, is Loulan’s father. Loulan went undercover in the rear palace as Shisui, Maomao’s bug-loving friend.
- Suirei is Loulan’s older half-sister. Her mother was a daughter of the former Emperor, which makes that woman Jinshi’s aunt by blood and Suirei his first cousin.


##


The Apothecary Diaries ships and pairings fans follow most


#


Ships in The Apothecary Diaries range from a slow-burn lead couple to quieter canon pairs in the background. These are the ones fans discuss most heading into The Apothecary Diaries Season 3.


###


Maomao and Jinshi


#


Maomao and Jinshi, shortened to “Jinmao” by fans, are the series’ flagship slow burn. It started with Jinshi’s dramatic pining and Maomao looking at him like something under a rock, and it has grown into real trust. This season he leans on her more openly than ever, but reviewers note there is still no big romantic breakthrough, so fans read every small gesture and worry about what his public role means for them.


###


Lakan and Fengxian


#


Lakan and Fengxian are Maomao’s birth parents and the series’ most bittersweet backstory. Fengxian was one of the few people whose face Lakan could recognize. After years apart, he bought out her contract with a fortune and made her his wife.


###


Gaoshun and Taomei


#


Gaoshun and Taomei are the steady married couple of the cast. They married young, have three children including Basen, and Taomei helped nurse Jinshi as a baby. Fans enjoy how the calm, capable Gaoshun is still nervous around his wife.


###


Lihaku and Pairin


#


Lihaku and Pairin are the soldier and the courtesan. In Season 1, Lihaku turns down Jinshi’s offer to pay Pairin’s contract because he wants to earn the money himself. Pairin, in turn, tells him she is not ready to leave the Verdigris House yet, which keeps the pairing open.


###


The Emperor and Empress Gyokuyou


#


The Emperor and Gyokuyou are the political pair at the top of the court. Gyokuyou began as his favored high consort, and by The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 she is Empress and the mother of the crown prince, so her family’s home region matters to the whole arc.


###


OC × canon in the fandom


#


The Apothecary Diaries has a niche but active OC x canon scene on AO3 and Tumblr. While Jinshi x Maomao dominates the mainstream shipping scene, the rich worldbuilding of the Rear Palace and Outer Court allows fans to build their own characters without breaking the story’s vibe. They can create their OC as apprentice apothecaries, ladies-in-waiting, or low-ranking officials. The Western Capital arc opens fresh territory, from merchants on the road west to village healers facing the famine.

##


FAQ


#


###


What is The Apothecary Diaries about?


#


The Apothecary Diaries follows Maomao, a young apothecary from the pleasure district who is kidnapped and sold into service at the imperial palace. She uses her knowledge of medicine and poisons to solve mysteries at court, often at Jinshi’s request. The story comes from a light novel series by Hyuganatsu, illustrated by Touko Shino.


###


Is Jinshi the Emperor’s son or brother in The Apothecary Diaries?


#


Jinshi in The Apothecary Diaries is publicly the Emperor’s younger brother, but Season 2 revealed he is biologically the Emperor’s son. His birth mother, Ah-Duo, swapped him at birth with Empress Dowager Anshi’s baby. In Season 3, the court still keeps that public cover and calls him the Imperial Brother.


###


Will Maomao return to the palace in The Apothecary Diaries Season 3?


#


Maomao starts The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 outside the rear palace, working as an apothecary in the pleasure district. She does not go back to her food taster post. Instead, Jinshi brings her on a trip west toward the Western Capital.


###


What is Ah-Duo’s role in The Apothecary Diaries Season 3?


#


[Ah-Duo](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/ah-duo-zkdra222bfml) , the Emperor’s former Pure Consort, returns in The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 as a quiet power behind the arc. Suirei now lives with her, and in episode 8 she also travels west with Consort Lishu, as flashbacks show her history with the Emperor. In The Apothecary Diaries family tree, she is also Jinshi’s birth mother.


###


Where can I watch The Apothecary Diaries?


#


The Apothecary Diaries streams on Crunchyroll in the US and most regions outside Asia, with English subtitles and an English dub. US viewers can also watch through the Crunchyroll channel on Prime Video. Netflix carries the series only in some Asian regions.


###


Is The Apothecary Diaries movie canon to Season 3?


#


The Apothecary Diaries movie, The Late Lady’s Treasure, is an original story by series creator Hyuganatsu rather than a light novel adaptation. It opens in Japanese theaters on December 11, 2026. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures plan a North American theatrical release, with no date announced yet.
